messages:
Elaine: Need a compact 1-page "cheat sheet" + 3 social tiles + hero slide for the Oct benchmark launch. Goal: quick ops playbook for infra and product teams.
Tom: What exact sizes and file types do you want?
Elaine: Hero 16:9 (1920x1080), cheat-sheet A4 print @300dpi (PDF), socials 1080x1080 x3, Twitter card 1200x675, mini infographic 600x400 (latency vs cost sparkline), decision tree 700x500 (Hosted vs Dedicated).
Pav: Visual treatment? illustrations/photos/accessibility?
Elaine: Flat illustrations, simple data tables with monospace numbers, brand palette v2 (navy/teal/sunrise accents). High contrast for WCAG. No photos.
Design-ops: Brand notes: include light/dark logo, 16px clearspace, provide SVGs for diagrams, PNG@2x for socials, and source Figma. I'll attach tokens and a short do/don't.
Elaine: Copy: Headline: "Benchmark your inference tradeoffs." Subhead: "Latency, cost, and quality 1 practical knobs for serving." CTA: "Register 1 Oct 5" Social tagline <=100 chars: "Practical benchmarks to cut cost without breaking latency."
Tom: Sparkline details?
Elaine: Show crossover where batching reduces cost but increases latency. Annotate with percent label (e.g., "-40% cost") and a small arrow. Keep chart minimal.
Pav: Micro-badges for quantized / fp16 / autoscale?
Elaine: Yes 1 three mono-outline badges with one-line notes under each.
Design-ops: Export naming: cheat_hero, cheat_sheet_v1, social_a..c, twitter_card, infographic_mini, decision_tree. Include Figma link and asset-checklist in handoff.
Sam-bot: Template uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xyz-cheatsheet-template
Tom: Scheduling a 25m review 9:30am PT tomorrow to go through roughs. Please RSVP.
Elaine: Thanks 1 ping me immediately if blocked on brand access or copy. :sparkles:
